reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: AI as defining imperative of the era
themes.definition: AI is named alongside climate and inequality as one of the defining global challenges facing humanity, without further elaboration in that passage.
themes.inclusion: Include passages that rank AI among the era's top global challenges or imperatives.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages with substantive discussion of specific AI risks or policies.
themes.boundary_cases: If the naming is purely a list of technologies rather than challenges, code AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION instead.

examples.quote: the defining imperatives of our era, namely artificial intelligence, the climate crisis, and deepening global inequalities

themes.label: AI as instrument of inequality or growth
themes.definition: Speaker questions whether AI will entrench global inequality or catalyse growth, insisting the Global South lead rather than spectate.
themes.inclusion: Include passages framing AI in terms of Global South exclusion or leadership in the technological revolution.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages that only list AI's benefits.
themes.boundary_cases: Assertions of Global South leadership backed by domestic AI initiatives are also coded AI_NATIONAL_STRATEGY.

examples.quote: Will the age of the AI become another instrument of global inequality, or will it be a catalyst for our collective growth?
We must ensure that the Global South leads this technological revolution rather than remain a helpless spectator.

themes.label: National AI initiatives and university
themes.definition: Speaker cites its own AI initiatives such as a coders programme and an AI university as proof of readiness.
themes.inclusion: Include references to national AI programmes, institutions or investments.
themes.exclusion: Exclude calls for international action without domestic initiatives.
themes.boundary_cases: Skills programmes may also be coded AI_YOUTH_EDUCATION.

examples.quote: the soon to be commissioned University of Artificial Intelligence reaffirms that our continent is ready to build the future

themes.label: Brief call for responsible AI use
themes.definition: A brief, general call to use AI responsibly for the benefit of humankind, without specific mechanisms.
themes.inclusion: Include short statements urging responsible or beneficial use of AI without detailing rules or institutions.
themes.exclusion: Exclude calls specifying treaties, frameworks or UN bodies (AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE).
themes.boundary_cases: If placed next to nuclear weapons without explicit military AI mention, do not code AI_MILITARY_WEAPONS.

examples.quote: We should also ensure that new technologies such as artificial intelligence are used responsibly, in a manner that benefits humankind.

value.rationale: Ethiopia's passages move from a brief 2023 call for responsible AI use to 2026 framing AI as a defining global imperative and an inequality question for Africa, backed by national AI initiatives.
